name: Playback Info Card
description: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.
overview: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.

versions.changelog: Release v0.2.5.2 - Prominent summary strip above the grid shows total active streams plus a genuine Direct/Transcoding split (correctly counts a paused Transcode session as Transcoding, not silently dropped). High-signal pills (resolution, dynamic range, audio, subtitle) now carry a leading icon so they scan at a glance; codec/bit-depth/container pills stay icon-free. The progress bar moves from the card footer to directly under the title for better visual hierarchy. Deeper "liquid glass" treatment (backdrop blur, saturation boost, specular highlight, bright/dim edge split) applied consistently across the card, badges, pills, chips, and Info drawer on both the dashboard widget and the standalone My Playback page.

Release v0.2.5.1 - Standalone My Playback page brought to full parity with the dashboard widget (Info-panel persistence fix, ETA/Atmos/audio-language/subtitle-method/avatar additions, matching artwork/badge/transcode-reason logic), removal of a dead MVC controller superseded by the dashboard middleware, and added test coverage for the notification delivery service's safe-degradation behavior when the plugin has not yet initialized.

Release v0.2.5.0 - Truthful transcode diagnostics additions: estimated finish time (ETA), Dolby Atmos/DTS:X detection, audio track language, and subtitle delivery method (surfaces burned-in subtitles as a genuine transcode cause) -- none inferred, all read directly from server-reported fields. Adds the user's own avatar next to their name and a layered cinema-poster shadow on artwork. Fixes a Remux/Transcode misclassification in the personal My Playback API, hardens secret storage (no more guessable fallback key, no silent ACL failures, no silent secret wipe on key mismatch), fixes a notification dedupe race condition, adds Brotli response support to the dashboard injector, and brings the Info-panel persistence fix to the standalone Playback Monitor page.

Release v0.2.4.1 - Singleton Info drawer that survives polling (fixes Info closing itself every 3s), real brand-accurate client logos (Chrome/Safari/Edge/Firefox/Brave and ~20 third-party/device clients replacing single-color placeholders), Remux/DirectPlay no longer show the Transcode-only "Reason not reported by server" text, corrected header method-count chip order (Direct Play/Direct Stream/Remux/Transcode/Paused, Remux always shown), expanded 26-field grouped technical breakdown, extended artwork fallback chain, and removal of a raw session-ID DOM leak in Connected Devices.

Release v0.2.4.0 - Corrective patch: complete in-place replacement of Jellyfin 12.1 Devices widget with strict exclusion of navigation drawer links, zero top-of-page fallback, connected devices preservation, and accessible 22-field technical breakdown drawer with distinct Source/Output resolution and container telemetry.
